name: Rimi e-commerce substitution guideline (sample)
description: Mandatory requirements are applied in code before any AI ranking. A product that fails a mandatory rule is never recommended. Preferences only affect the order of eligible products.

quantity.note: Replacement quantity = ordered total amount / substitute package size, rounded up to a whole package (minimum 1).

mandatory.description: The substitute must belong to the same product category as the unavailable product.
The total cost of the replacement may exceed the original order line by at most 20 % or 2.00 EUR, whichever is smaller. Cheaper substitutes are always allowed.
The total replacement amount may deviate from the ordered amount by at most 30 %.
If the unavailable product has a dietary property (lactose-free, gluten-free, vegan, organic, sugar-free), the substitute must have the same property.

preferences.description: Prefer the same fat content / variant.
Prefer the same product type (e.g. white toast vs rye).
Prefer the package size closest to the original.
When otherwise equal, prefer the Rimi private label.
